subject: windmill
summary: Dressed stone piers carry an open arcade. A ring below each capital marks the springing of the arches. A lip separates the dome from the drum. One dark window sits in the drum. The sails stay thin plates on the front of the cap.

pier.note: square stone columns under the arcade

drum.note: the stone cylinder between the arcade and the dome

sail.note: the sail plates already in the build

window.note: the dark opening in the drum, cleared one block deep

arch.note: empty cells inside the arcade, used by the check

pier_ring.note: a vertical plate, two thirds of the way up each pier, flush to the pier

pier_plinth.note: a vertical plate around the foot of each pier, flush to the pier

cap_lip.note: a vertical plate around the lower edge of the dome, flush to the cap
